facts.fact: A thatched tack room beside the fort kalari, with two roof leaks and two buckets, is where Devan restrings bows on the rain-locked day.
facts.why: needed because the rain-locked scene needs a private covered place near the pit.

facts.fact: The raider captain Devan killed at 24 was taken at the lower ford after a village was burned; Muthu opened his arm and saw the killing. Devan struck the marma point in the notch below the ear with two fingers.
facts.why: needed because the disclosure must name the exact strike; Muthu's presence matches the secret map (Devan, Muthu know).

facts.fact: Devan has filled Neela's kindi himself every night since the second week, spout toward the pillow because she reaches left-handed.
facts.why: pays off F105 (she assumed Janu's girls fill it) as an act of responsive care.

facts.fact: Neela skips resin on the rain night of chapter 21 because the rain washed the scent from the hill, so Devan does not use the pebble that night. Her nails itch.
facts.why: needed so she can be human and asleep beside him for the night scene.

facts.fact: Neela tells Devan she was six when taken, lost her birth name on the road, and thinks Chathu has it in a ledger.
facts.why: needed for the disclosure that she has a number, not a name.
